a.lede: AI-generated songs are filling Spotify and other platforms. These vocal, lyric and instrumental tells can help you catch them before you hit play.
a.title: AI music can be difficult to detect, but there are some telltale signs

b.lede: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices with different personalities, or turn off the commentary between songs.
b.title: Spotify’s AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
